final_account.disclaimer: This output is a calculation aid only. Final accounts must be agreed between the parties and certified by the Superintending Officer in accordance with contract conditions.

water_demand.name: Water Demand Calculation
water_demand.formula: Production Demand = (Pop × Per Capita + Comm + Ind) × (1 + NRW%)

sub_formulas.peak_day: Peak Day = Production × Peak Day Factor
sub_formulas.peak_hour: Peak Hour = Production × Peak Hour Factor

water_demand.disclaimer: This output is an engineering calculation aid only. Water supply designs must comply with SPAN UTG and be endorsed by a registered PE. Contact local water operator for final approval.
